text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3.Applicant should be between 18 and 40 4.Be in good health condition 5.With reliable financial support and custody. 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6.Certificate of Chinese language education Applicants who want to be enrolled as a sophomore or junior in Chinese Language majors shall submit the certificate of full-time Chinese training and academic record in original or notarized copy in English or Chinese
